title: Chandrayaan-2 × LRO multi-modal patch
description: Synthetic demo triplet approximating OHRC, LRO NAC, and IIRS-derived products of the same lunar region under different illumination and scale.

sensorInfo.label: OHRC-like (Chandrayaan-2)
sensorInfo.notes: High-resolution optical, similar to Chandrayaan-2 OHRC (~0.25–0.32 m/px).

sensorInfo.label: LRO NAC-like reference
sensorInfo.notes: Reference map-like product similar to LRO Narrow Angle Camera imagery.

sensorInfo.label: IIRS-like (Chandrayaan-2)
sensorInfo.notes: Hyperspectral-derived grayscale proxy for IIRS mineralogical context; demo C is XML with embedded PNG pixels.
